name: Slack
description: Full Slack workspace integration — read channels, search messages, manage saved items, post messages, add reactions, and manage user groups. Equivalent to the korotovsky/slack-mcp-server feature set, via browser session auth.
author: flock

requires.description: Log into your Slack workspace via the dashboard browser session
requires.rationale: Many Slack workspaces block bot token installs — a saved browser session uses your existing login with no admin approval needed.
